The '''LCS 2020 Summer Split''' was the second split of the third year of franchised play in the [[League of Legends Championship Series]] (LCS), organized by Riot Games. It took place from June 13 to September 6, 2020, with both the Regular Season and Playoffs held in Los Angeles, United States. Ten partner teams competed in a Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo1}} Regular Season, followed by a Double Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} Playoff bracket. The total prize pool was $200,000 USD, and the top three teams from the Playoffs qualified for the [[World Championship/2020|2020 World Championship]].

The split featured roster adjustments across multiple organizations, including [[TSM]]’s acquisition of [[Doublelift]] from [[Team Liquid]]. Due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, the competition was primarily played online, with the Finals concluding remotely.

==Format==
* '''Group Stage'''
**Double Round Robin
**Each team plays 18 matches.
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}
**Top 8 qualifies to the Summer Playoffs
*** Top 6 teams are seeded into Winner Bracket
*** Remaining 2 teams are seeded into Loser Bracket
*** 1st and 2nd place teams from Group Stage will receive a bye. 
* '''Playoffs'''
** Double Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
** Top 3 qualify for [[World_Championship/2020|Worlds 2020]]
